branch_families.behavior: Only MinTokens instantiated. Custom processors rejected; min_p/logit_bias warned inactive. No hidden MinP/bias work to erase in fixed DSpark.
All-greedy returns before random filtering/noise; mixed saves greedy decisions before random-only processing, merges by original temperature predicate.

Raw values precede mutation; FP32 raw-target clone currently unconditional in raw mode. Requested topk/selected scores need original logsoftmax, target token score and > rank, not only argmax. Ascend rejection return path gates requested scores on max_num_logprobs.

Target penalties then allowed mask/badword/MinTokens; bonus path has its own allowed/badword/processor/penalty order. Histories expand committed output with preceding speculative prefixes; -1 output placeholders mapped to vocab padding before histogram.

Prompt/output int32 atomic histograms + FP32 sign-conditioned repetition scaling, frequency then presence. Integer prefix counts/prompt-mask caching is a distinct representation candidate; none of this runs under no_penalties. Do not reassociate FP32 operations or interleave histogram updates without a join.
Mask stop tokens in each appropriate draft prefix; save pre-mask stop logits and restore finite stops only when entire row otherwise -inf. A simple union-of-masks kernel can lose this dependency.

Committed outputs, draft prefixes, start/end/countdown and force-index transitions; bonus call updates state then target call uses forcing. Newest accepted state and previous output length are not speculative -1 placeholders; do not swap the two calls or reuse masks across generations.

Ascend native path returns exact alias if both absent; otherwise sorts FP32 probabilities and preserves threshold ties. TopP cutoff uses unfiltered probabilities even when TopK masks logits. Batch-invariant dispatches upstream sorted-logit semantics, not an interchangeable algorithm.

Bonus draws global exponential plane unless fully seeded, then seeded row overrides on global stream and explicit join. Recovered draws global BxV exponential plane unconditionally plus seeded overrides; one q per request shared across positions. Uniform requests FP64 global plane then per-request seeded slice, zero-draft seeded slices skipped; Triton callers cast to FP32. Preserve shape/order/dtype/offsets.

K1 special only when every K=1 and is_greedy None. General greedy first mismatch + target token, all match bonus; random first rejection and recovered row; K0 bonus. Suffix remains -1 and no cross-request unmasked preceding-element load.

branch_families.guard: enable_block_verify and maxK>=3; entropy flag independent
branch_families.behavior: Block scans all K, sequential pi=min(pi*p/q,1) and cumulative uniforms, records last qualifying position; cannot stop at first failure. Entropy uses raw ori probabilities when present, FP32 log/prod/reduction order retained.

None means onehot correction by zeroing proposed token; full uses max(p-q,0). Triton chunks4096, strict cross-chunk > retains earliest winner; q shared across K. Lazy recovery of only selected emitted row is possible only after original verify decision and unchanged complete RNG advancement; inactive random branch under fixed loads.

Pytorch fallback has vector masks, first/last prefix selection and explicit q==0/isinf handling; not bit-interchangeable with Triton. Blockwise recovery helper flag defaults false and ordinary call does not forward block flag. Synthetic+block raises ValueError; synthetic rates alter acceptance and cannot be used as a performance replacement.

price.scope: First eager reply only per request. Original target/sample readiness, CPU output-thread handoff, copy/event duration, all draft compute/submission and downstream work retained. No cross-wave cumulative or throughput/response-end credit.
price.qualification: CANN API/device timestamps and source-motif matching are approximate; event handles and copy byte counts are absent. Nine unique reply-thread waits end within35.025us of late record; offset sensitivity retained. First-ID delivery to first nonempty client chunk remains a propagation assumption until service admission. No realized speedup.

candidates.scope: Direct early-copy patch without next-input generation protocol
candidates.depth: native backend counterexample plus persistent CPU staging source
candidates.reason: Pinned INT32[24]/INT64[16] copy_ did not snapshot original bytes while event pending: all24/16 elements became overwritten values. Independent-generation controls retained all original bytes. This is a deterministic ownership discriminator, not evidence of an observed race in unmodified service. Default-stream order does not order CPU writes to pinned input buffers.

candidates.reason: No active work to remove on specified calls. Source design boundaries retained for workload change; no new RNG/penalty profile or native probe justified now.

retirement.constraint: Async KV loads are not default-stream ordered; processed_step_seq assumes completed writes. No KV/EC guard preserves fallback. Ascend block zero and CoW are current-stream operations; CoW snapshots GPU source before writes. CPU _ids_pinned and CpuGpuBuffer.cpu are mutable, however, and their H2D readers can remain queued behind old draft work when CPU queues another generation. Default-stream order does not protect CPU overwrites.
retirement.not_accepted: Native backend test refutes source-snapshot assumption only, not a full-service race witness. Need per-buffer lease/read-complete or immutable generation snapshots; only then qualify EOS/abort/same-ID/DP-empty and all relevant secondary streams.

result.scope: INT32[24] and INT64[16] pinned H2D copy_ under a pending stream event, compared with independent-generation staging. BF16 GEMM is bounded gate work only, not a speed benchmark or model qualification.

native_staging_discriminator.scope: Backend ownership parameter only; no replacement primitive/model performance acceptance. a1 setup error before NPU retained, a2 one isolated NPU process with current16-worker queue/env match and health200 before/after.
